task.pr_title: Allow didChange to operate on tracked source text directly

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
I think this is problematic -if a didChange/Open/Close comes for not the 'main' workspace (and we're not looking up which solution/workspace it belongs to), then we're not clearing the cache.  

I can think of two possible answers
1.  We just clear all workspaces
2.  We need to lookup and store the workspace for mutating requests, even if we don't actually fork the solution

evidence.thread_resolution: davidwengier: You're right, this should be fixed. Interestingly this means we don't need the extra logging you just added today, because we need a non-null return from GetDocumentIdentifier for the mutating requests 😛
